notes.title: Elasto Mania Remastered
notes.content:
Elasto Mania has seen a lot of changes in the past two years, including an additional update today. This update adds two more level packs by the community contributor Sla to the game, as well as remastered graphics, based on original, never-before-seen high quality assets.

The culmination of the past years of work are thus here, and to mark this day, 22 years after the original launch, we're renaming this new version of Elasto Mania to Elasto Mania Remastered. This brings the Steam version in line with the newly launched console and other platforms.

We hope you continue to enjoy this game and look forward to even more elma-adventures!

notes.title: Online Play - Early Access
notes.content:
Online Play is the beginning of a new feature built for Elasto Mania Remastered.
It is currently in alpha - expect that things will break and data can be reset at any time.

The goal at the current stage is to test server stability and potential issues.
Feedback is welcome at info@elastomania.com, on the Steam forums, or on Discord.

Note that this is a separate feature from the community-maintained EOL (Elasto Mania Online) mod.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 2021-03-13
notes.content:
The previous update available in beta is now released globally.

- When starting the game with a new profile, play a set of Tutorial levels (these levels can also be replayed later and have leaderboards, but are not meant for competing)
- Reverted the first internal level to its original (pre-tutorial) state
- Removed the display of controls when playing the first level
- Added an option to customize the behavior of the View (Minimap)
- Updated filesystem management, greatly reducing the number of disk reads and writes
- Some additional small changes and fixes

An update has been released on the beta branch containing a small number of changes that will be incorporated into the upcoming larger update and launch of the console versions.

- When starting the game with a new profile, play a set of Tutorial levels (these levels can also be replayed later and have leaderboards, but are not meant for competing)
- Reverted the first internal level to its original (pre-tutorial) state
- Removed the display of controls when playing the first level
- Added an option to customize the behavior of the View (Minimap)
- Updated filesystem management, greatly reducing the number of disk reads and writes
- Some additional small changes and fixes

notes.title: End of 2020 update & sale
notes.content:
[h1]54 more levels[/h1]
The Stolen Internals level pack by Sla contains 54 levels that are sure to challenge you. Each of them puts a creative twist on the original Elasto Mania levels and will force you to use your brains just as much as your reflexes! This collection of levels comes with its own Achievements and Leaderboards.

[h1]Game controller support[/h1]
One of the most requested feature has been native game controller support with force feedback. So now we have added it! Feel the gentle vibration and the occasional roar of the engine right in your hands.

[h1]Better local multiplayer[/h1]
Want to play through Elasto Mania with a friend? Now you can! Local Multiplayer is now played just like Singleplayer, allowing you to unlock levels as you progress, or skip them if you can't. And with game controller support, you won't need to fight over keyboard layouts anymore.

[h1]Additional changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Moved to a modern 64-bit environment, with support for multiple rendering methods
[*]Unified resolution in menu for consistency, better selection of gameplay resolution
[*]Windowed mode support
[*]Delete player option
[*]Sound-related fixes
[/list]

The discount begins Nov 5, 2020 10:00am (Seattle time).

notes.title: World Cup 8
notes.content:
Our amazing community has been hard at work organizing the newest Elasto Mania World Cup. It has now been three and a half years since the last World Cup and it is once again time to find the best player in the world.

[b]The Elasto Mania World Cup 8 will start tomorrow on August 30th![/b]

This World Cup will have 12 one-week events with some breaks in between. To participate, subscribe to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2094059600]Elma Online Workshop item[/url], remember to save your replays, and upload them on the world cup site: [url=https://wcup.site]https://wcup.site[/url].

To get a taste of what to expect, see the Elasto Mania World Cup 7 movie by iCS:
[previewyoutube=Y1Ri_Y_pGGM;full][/previewyoutube]

The Elasto Mania Team thanks the organizers and the entire Elasto Mania Community for creating this event.

notes.title: Action SuperCross on Steam
notes.content:
The predecessor of Elasto Mania and grandfather of all physics-based motorbike simulation games is launching on Steam in just a couple of days, on June 17! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1339620/Action_SuperCross/]Add it to your wishlist to be sure not to miss the launch discount: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1339620/Action_SuperCross/[/url]

The release is accompanied by a special surprise. With the help of the community, we have uncovered something amazing: an official level pack for Action SuperCross, made from previously unreleased and early versions of levels.

[previewyoutube=Z75zzjViGPM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]This level pack will be available free of charge to everyone who owns Action SuperCross on Steam.
[/b]
